releases.description: Welcome to the very first release of Apollo. A modern, high-fidelity music player for Windows built for audiophiles and music lovers.
changelog: WASAPI Exclusive Mode for bit-perfect, unaltered audio playback.
Studio-grade DSP including a 10-band parametric Equalizer, Compressor, Limiter, Reverb, and Saturation.
Lightning-fast SQLite library database capable of handling 100,000+ tracks.
Auto-fetching word-by-word synced lyrics via the LRCLIB API.
Full Windows integration: System Media Transport Controls (SMTC) and media key support.
Smart File Association: Double-click any audio file to play instantly in the existing window.
Modern Liquid Glass UI with custom timeline, queue management, and dynamic music mode.
Persistent settings, play counts, and favorites tracking.
Song playing issue fixed: when one song finished, the next one started randomly instead of the actual next song.
Issue fixed: when a song ended, the pause button didn't change to Play.
